protocol.split: the training window ends strictly before the test window begins; enforced in code by Window
protocol.threshold: each arm's own out-of-fold training residuals, at the 1 % quantile, one-sided (overheating only)

C7_lead_time.note: The rolling 30-day reference is re-estimated every day. The alarm is the matched one-sided rule, at 1 % and 5 %.

C8_care_thermal_subset.protocol: the committed CARE evaluation, restricted to the anomaly events whose window contains rows in normal operation
